measurement_limits: Byte counts are UTF-8, not model tokens, cache charges, latency or statistical reliability.
two_session_fixed_plus_skills_bytes includes two Session instruction deliveries and all returned platform Skill resources; excludes schemas, dynamic prompts, history, images and help output.
Settings help/tool counts come from deduplicated ACP call IDs. Only help outputs with no diagnostic truncation are counted; other activity result byte counts are not used.
GitLab full tool outputs are restored from the actual DSH event archive; output bytes include business evidence and reports, not only guidance.
All model scenarios use isolated local platform fixtures; no real platform business acceptance or S2a tool/subagent matrix is claimed.
